lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to Le Petit Bistro. How many people?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Here are your menus. What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: I'm sorry, we don't have iced tea today. How about lemonade?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Lemonade sounds good. And I'd like a sandwich, please.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Great choice. Is there anything else?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No, thank you. Could we have the bill, please?
